training.description: Explore UK drama schools, conservatoires and alternative training routes. Compare course formats, funding, location and audition requirements.
training.body:
Choose a training route

agents.title: UK acting agents and talent agencies
agents.description: Find UK acting agencies and representation resources, and learn how to research and approach the right agent.
agents.body:
How to choose representation

Look for an agency whose roster and work align with your skills and career stage. Check its official submission instructions, whether it is accepting approaches, and which department handles actors. An agent can help with submissions and contracts, but representation is not a guarantee of work.

Agency and representation directory

Before you apply

  • Prepare a current headshot, accurate CV and a short reel or scenes.
  • Read the agency’s submission rules and tailor your introduction.
  • Keep a record of dates and responses; respect closed books.
  • Review commission, exclusivity and termination terms before signing.

casting.title: UK acting auditions and casting resources
casting.description: Explore UK casting platforms, industry bodies and open-call resources, with practical advice for finding legitimate auditions.
casting.body:
Where to start

headshots.title: Actor headshots in the UK
headshots.description: Practical guidance on choosing, preparing for and using professional actor headshots in the UK.
headshots.body:
What a casting headshot needs to do

A useful acting headshot is current, recognisable and appropriate for the work you seek. It should help a casting professional understand how you might appear on screen or stage rather than disguise your appearance.

Plan your materials

  • Compare complete session prices and the number of finished photographs.
  • Choose clothing and styling that support your casting range.
  • Ask about retouching, usage rights and delivery before booking.
  • Keep your headshots consistent with your CV and showreel.

Explore the guides

  • First professional actor headshots in London: detailed guide and examples
  • Headshots, CVs and showreels
  • When to update your headshots

about.title: About Acting UK
about.description: An independent, free-to-browse editorial guide for actors in the British acting industry.
about.body:
Why Acting UK exists

Acting UK brings together practical career guidance, training, casting and representation resources for actors at different stages. The directory is selective and is not an official accreditation or ranking.

Who publishes the site

Acting UK is published by Kirill Kozlov, a London photographer with professional experience creating actor headshots. Our articles are editorial resources, not advice from a casting director, lawyer or immigration adviser unless explicitly attributed to a qualified contributor.

Our standards

Read our editorial policy, directory methodology and author information. We distinguish published information from first-hand experience and link to original sources when available.

editorial-policy.title: Editorial policy
editorial-policy.description: How Acting UK researches, presents and corrects information about the UK acting industry.
editorial-policy.body:
Research and verification

We use original provider information, official industry bodies and government guidance where relevant. We distinguish factual claims, editorial interpretation and practical suggestions. Time-sensitive information should be checked against the original source before acting on it.

Independence and conflicts

Inclusion is not an endorsement or ranking. Acting UK’s publisher also operates a photography business; where it is featured, we disclose the relationship. Editorial assessments based on public information are not first-hand reviews of services.

Corrections and updates

We aim to correct material errors and update changed guidance. Contact information and submission details can change; use the original provider’s instructions. See contact and corrections.

directory-methodology.title: Directory methodology
directory-methodology.description: How Acting UK selects, describes and maintains professional resources and acting coach profiles.
directory-methodology.body:
Selection

The directory includes selected resources relevant to actors in the UK, including training, representation, casting, support and news. Inclusion is not a claim of accreditation, availability or endorsement.

Editorial assessments

Coaching profiles describe publicly available professional information and offer an editorial assessment of possible suitability. They are not claims that we attended a lesson or independently tested the service.

Verification and corrections

Check official sources for current prices, eligibility, locations and availability. We do not publish unverified private contact details. Request corrections through the contact page. See our editorial policy.

authors.title: Authors and contributors
authors.description: Who is responsible for Acting UK’s editorial content and professional guidance.
authors.body:
Publisher and editorial responsibility

Kirill Kozlov publishes Acting UK and has professional experience in actor portrait and headshot photography. Articles attributed to Acting UK editorial are compiled for this publication. Individual contributors and reviewers will be named only where their involvement is established.

Scope of expertise

Professional-materials guidance draws on relevant experience; legal, immigration, tax and employment information should be checked with official sources or appropriately qualified advisers. See editorial standards.

contact.title: Contact and corrections
contact.description: How to report a factual error, outdated resource or technical issue on Acting UK.
contact.body:
Report a correction

Please identify the page URL, the detail that needs correcting and a reliable source supporting the change. For directory updates, include the organisation’s official public information.

How to reach us

Use the Acting UK website issue tracker for public website corrections and technical issues. Do not include private personal information or confidential documents in a public issue. A dedicated editorial contact address has not yet been published.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How Acting UK uses browser storage and handles links to other websites.
privacy.body:
Browser storage

Acting UK uses local browser storage to remember your saved resources and personal career checklist on your device. You can clear these through the homepage’s saved-data control or your browser settings.

External sites

Some pages link to third-party websites or load external images. These services have their own privacy practices; we do not control their processing. GitHub Pages hosts the site.

Questions

For website privacy questions, see contact information. Do not share sensitive information in public issue reports.
